credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only. Authentication denial, rate limiting, truncation, and service failure are recorded as access failures and never converted into negative search results.

immutable_ref_rules.repo_local: bind results to the current base commit and tree
immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: bind pinned results to lake-manifest revision and Git tree; do not update, fetch, clone, checkout, or build dependencies
immutable_ref_rules.external: a candidate receives source credit only after a branch or search hit is resolved to a 40-hex commit and source blob/tree is inspected at that commit
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: dated response hashes are bounded discovery evidence, not immutable proof evidence

expected_negative_evidence: For local searches record exact queries, path scope, exit status, and result file-list hash. For public searches record completion/truncation state, repository and match counts where supplied, response SHA-256, and access limitations. A bounded zero result does not prove internet-wide absence.
classification_policy: Normalize every discovered declaration against the exact frozen positive-finite-variable field target. Statement-only or interface-only artifacts are M3, partial closure is M2, credible independently reproducible external kernel closure is M1, mismatched, placeholder-bearing, incompatible, or unverifiable candidates are M5, and M0 requires accepted repo-local kernel validation through an exact wrapper.
credit_boundary: This protocol governs bounded candidate discovery only. It cannot supply proof, H0, R0, AUDIT-Z, master acceptance, or theorem-completion credit.
